title: Verifying LLM-Generated Code in the Context of Software Verification with Ada/SPARK

live_model.evidence: Abstract: "Marmaragan with GPT-4o...correct annotations generated for 50.7% of the benchmark cases"; "the model gpt-4o-2024-05-13" (Sec. 5.1).

prompt.location: Listing 2 ("The base prompt used to query the LLM"), Sec. 2.3
prompt.note: Base prompt for generating SPARK annotations; chain-of-thought variant and medium-in-prompt feature also described.

claim.location: Abstract / Sec. 5.2 ("71 (50.7%) of the benchmark cases"); Table 2 (per-benchmark breakdown)

data.source: curated set of SPARK/Ada programs (drawn from open-source repositories), released with the Marmaragan tool

notes: Correctness is verified automatically via SPARK/GNATprove formal verification, not an LLM judge. Some configurations use N=5 sampled solutions with retries (Table 1), which would raise the call count for those specific rows above the base N=1 estimate used here.
